_comment: Weighted 6-slot fill for chiseled bookshelves placed by the structure processor. See docs/EXTENDING.md. Schema v2: book_count / enchanted_book_probability / enchanted_book_selection.

enchanted_book_selection._comment: Per-candidate weight = base_weight (from loot_injections.json) * vanilla_weight_factor(Enchantment.getWeight()) * max_level_weight_ratio ^ relative_level. relative_level = (level-1)/(maxLevel-1) for maxLevel>1, else 0 -- so a book at its enchantment's max level (Sharpness V, Blast Protection IV, Mending I, ...) all get the same relative_level=1 penalty regardless of the numeric level, and Mending (maxLevel=1) is never level-penalised at all. max_level_weight_ratio=0.1 means a max-level book is ~1/10 as likely to appear as a level-1 book of the same enchantment, with an exponential curve in between.
